notes.0-4: 'she softened her pitch when the investors frowned' = the highness of her voice or her persuasive speech
notes.2-3: 'the roofer checked the pitch of the old roof' = the tar coating the roof or its slope (pitch is a traditional roofing material)

notes.1-3: 'a bank of spare batteries' / 'a memory bank' = a stored reserve or a row of units
notes.1-4: 'the village grain bank lent seed to farmers' / 'the bank's reserves' = a store of supplies or a lending institution; a bank is literally a store of money
